2149:  * Global host first-stage invalidation barrier for one or two devices of the
2150:  * same IOMMU. The caller owns the HPM session (hpm_lock), has quiesced the
2151:  * relevant DMA and serializes binding changes. Both endpoint locks are held
2152:  * across validation and command submission, taken in ascending device id
2153:  * order, and no domain->lock is taken. This only issues IOTINVAL.VMA with
2154:  * GV/AV/PSCV clear followed by a fence; it is not an ATS/PR/PW or general
2155:  * internal-state reset, and it never retries or resets on failure.
2156:  *
2157:  * Note on the current RTL: CQH advances when the fetch of the last beat
2158:  * completes, before decode. For this strict no-ATS/no-S2, quiesced
2159:  * experiment the CQ decodes the earlier VMA (its invalidations are issued
2160:  * before the fetch of the following IOFENCE), so CQH passing the following
2161:  * fence is sufficient evidence that the VMA pulse was issued. This is not a
2162:  * general fence-execution proof.
